evals.prompt: Add project renaming to this existing client app. It already has organization membership and an API. Editors may rename, viewers may not. The new name must survive reload.
assertions: Inspects and reuses existing contracts and components
Enforces permission and organization scope on the server
Validates input and verifies persistence after reload
Tests denied direct requests and a consequential failure case

evals.prompt: Our create-project request sometimes times out, and retry produces duplicate projects. Fix the actual behavior.
assertions: Distinguishes unknown write outcome from confirmed rejection
Inspects service and database contract before choosing idempotency or reconciliation
Does not rely only on disabling a button
Verifies one logical operation cannot cause duplicate effects

evals.prompt: Connect the prototype to our real scheduling API. The credentials are not available in this checkout.
assertions: Completes safe local integration work with explicit boundaries
Does not fabricate a working real service
Names the missing dependency and limits of local verification
Does not expose or invent credentials
